question: Does widening the starting placement by one rank unlock root legal ray actions outside the directions exposed by every current preset?
interpretation: A deterministic synthetic setup spreading owner 0 over ranks 0-2 and owner 1 over ranks 3-5 exposed 88/127 pairs and produced candidates in all eight directions. Every accepted semantic root had both anchors safe. This contrasts with 42-51 exposed pairs and only three directions across all existing two-rank presets. The result supports setup structure as a separate coverage axis for a future opt-in generator, not a default change or utility claim.
limitations: Synthetic three-rank fixtures, not a supported preset or sample from a full joint generator distribution.
Layout acceptance used legacy anchor-safety and legal-opening-move bounds; semantic per-pair initial check status was separately zero in all 127 rows.
Root legal actions only; no games, outcomes, search, training, calibration or utility.
